definitions.def: to decide or find out something after thinking about it
to know or remember something you have seen before
to put things into groups by type
to try very hard to achieve something
to explain the meaning of something

grammar_choice.en_template: The process we go through when we look at a work of art {{1:to determine/determining}} if we recognize and can make sense of its content {{2:is/are}} not just a visual one.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 우리가 어떤 미술 작품을 볼 때 그 내용을 알아보고 이해할 수 있는지를 판단하기 위해 거치는 과정은 단지 시각적인 것만은 아니다.
explain: '판단하기 위해' — 목적의 부사적 to부정사 to determine.

grammar_choice.en_template: It is a mental process as well, largely {{1:based/basing}} on the elements within and about the work {{2:that/what}} we can identify and categorize.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 그것은 또한 정신적인 과정이기도 한데, 주로 우리가 식별하고 분류할 수 있는 작품 안과 작품에 관한 요소들에 기반한다.
explain: 선행사 the elements 있는 목적격 관계대명사 → that(what 불가).

grammar_choice.en_template: As we look and think, we may {{1:be given/give}} clues about {{2:what/that}} the work means by where it is, when it was made, what culture it came from, who created it, or why it was made.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 우리가 보고 생각함에 따라, 작품이 어디에 있는지, 언제 만들어졌는지, 어느 문화에서 왔는지, 누가 만들었는지, 왜 만들어졌는지에 의해 작품의 의미에 관한 단서를 얻을 수 있다.
explain: means의 목적어가 빠진 불완전한 절 → 의문사 what.

grammar_choice.en_template: We should strive {{1:to understand/understanding}} a work of art as we see it, without {{2:being influenced/influencing}} by the background of the work, its creator, or its historical context.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 우리는 작품의 배경, 창작자, 또는 역사적 맥락에 영향을 받지 않고, 보이는 그대로 미술 작품을 이해하려고 노력해야 한다.
explain: 주어가 영향을 '받는' 대상 → without + 동명사 수동형 being influenced.

grammar_choice.en_template: Any information we can gather {{1:helps/help}} us understand the work's context, that is, for what historical, social, personal, political, or scientific reasons the work of art {{2:was made/made}}.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 우리가 모을 수 있는 어떤 정보든 작품의 맥락, 즉 그 미술 작품이 어떤 역사적·사회적·개인적·정치적·과학적 이유로 만들어졌는지를 이해하는 데 도움이 된다.
explain: 주어 핵 = Any information(단수 취급) → helps.

grammar_choice.en_template: And then, {{1:using/used}} all the contextual information we have gathered, we interpret the work of art's content {{2:to discover/discovering}} what it means or symbolizes.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 그런 다음, 우리가 모은 모든 맥락 정보를 활용하여, 우리는 그 작품의 내용을 해석해 그것이 무엇을 의미하거나 상징하는지를 발견한다.
explain: '발견하기 위해' — 목적의 부사적 to부정사 to discover.

jumble.answer: The process we go through when we look at a work of art to determine if we recognize and can make sense of its content is not just a visual one.
It is a mental process as well, largely based on the elements within and about the work we can identify and categorize.
As we look and think, we may be given clues about what the work means by where it is, when it was made, what culture it came from, who created it, or why it was made.
We should strive to understand a work of art as we see it, without being influenced by the background of the work, its creator, or its historical context.
Any information we can gather helps us understand the work's context, that is, for what historical, social, personal, political, or scientific reasons the work of art was made.
And then, using all the contextual information we have gathered, we interpret the work of art's content to discover what it means or symbolizes.
